answers.how: The handle diameter is approximately 55 px and the puck diameter 31.2 px: 55/31.2 × 0.074.
Around 0.5 s, the puck moves approximately 279.5 px/s; converted using 0.074 m per 31.2 px.
Around 2.0 s, the puck moves approximately 106.7 px/s; converted using 0.074 m per 31.2 px.
The handle centers are approximately 87 px apart horizontally: 87/31.2 × 0.074.
The minimum center-to-center distance is approximately 84 px, when the puck passes level with the right handle: 84/31.2 × 0.074.
